analysis_scope.endpoint_claim: prefix endpoint only; no final quality or convergence inference
analysis_scope.metadata: Original archives, run metadata and configurations remain unchanged

definitions.phase: 1..T within accepted rollouts; phase T includes final rollout step and commit corrections
definitions.interval: starts at first listed accepted endpoint; ends at last listed accepted endpoint
definitions.normals: arm-specific frozen 33NN centroid-offset normal at common endpoint
definitions.tangent_basis: t1=normalize(cross(global_y,n)); use global_x where abs(n_y)>0.9; t2=cross(n,t1)
definitions.path_share: sum of phase-T displacement lengths / sum of all raw displacement lengths
definitions.reversal: negative consecutive displacement dot; both lengths exceed 1e-4 source-native spacing
definitions.speed: geometric endpoint displacement/dt; distinct from recorded terminal state mean speed
definitions.attribution: Archive cannot separate last physical step, layer changes, commit PIC and subgrid shift
